The '''''Fortune's Folly''''' was a [[Luxury liner/Legends|pleasure barge]] owned by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bask Sunn]], a [[Dar'manda]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] and [[Recruitment officer/Legends|recruitment officer]]. In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.2}}</ref> the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] participated in the [[Attack on the Spirit of Vengeance II|assault]] on the ''[[Spirit of Vengeance II]]''.<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />

[[File:DarmandaMandoShip.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Fortune's Folly'' during the [[Attack on the Spirit of Vengeance II|Attack on the ''Spirit of Vengeance II'']]]]
The ''Fortune's Folly'' was a combination pleasure barge and raiding vessel used by the Dar'manda which provided an opulent lifestyle for the officers of the organization. The lower ranked members of the organization, however, were housed in cramped quarters and lived an impoverished existence, with only glimpses of the benefits offered to the uppermost echelons of the organization as an incentive for advancement.<ref name="Codex" />
